description.value: The Grind is a cafe located at 1006 Beach Avenue in Vancouver's West End, positioned directly along the city's iconic seawall cycling route. It offers vegan and vegetarian menu options alongside both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists completing the seawall loop. Its outdoor patio faces one of Vancouver's busiest recreational corridors.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (7 spaces) at 6m; stands (7 spaces) at 19m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 77m. Total: 20 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM website URL points to an Instagram profile, which served only a login wall with no business-specific content; all amenity evidence therefore comes from OSM tags alone. OSM confirms diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes, and outdoor_seating=yes, but provides no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most optional amenities. The cafe sits on Beach Avenue along Vancouver's seawall, a major cycling corridor, and OSM shows no closure indicators.
concerns: Website URL is an Instagram profile that serves a login wall to unauthenticated users — no business-specific content was retrievable; all amenity data relies on OSM tags only.
No phone number listed in OSM record.
Unit number (110) present in OSM addr:unit tag but omitted from the OSM address field; full address is 1006 Beach Avenue, Unit 110, Vancouver, BC V6Z 2N9.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open cafe on the Vancouver seawall — one of the most heavily cycled routes in BC. Directly useful to touring cyclists regardless of unconfirmed amenities.

wow_evidence: positioned directly along the city's iconic seawall cycling route... outdoor_seating=yes
